title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Part of an Endorsement Charge Given Back on Cancellation
content:
**Endorsement charges of the current term on cancellation — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)**

The endorsement fraction is the part of each endorsement charge of the current term (risk premium and reserve fund assessment lines) taken back on cancellation, judged on the coverage increase most recently put into effect — the coverage-increase endorsement with the latest effective date:

1. **1** when the coverage increase took effect after the cancellation date, because it was never in force;
2. **the days from the cancellation date to the term end divided by the days from the increase's effective date to the term end** when it took effect after the term start and on or before the cancellation date;
3. **the term share** (the days from the cancellation date to the term end divided by the days of the current term) otherwise.

| Increase effective date | Fraction |
|---|---|
| After the cancellation date | 1 |
| After the term start, on or before the cancellation date | Days cancellation-to-term-end over days increase-to-term-end |
| On or before the term start, or no increase in effect | Term share |

*Hypothetical case.* An increase effective with 200 days left in the term, cancelled with 100 days left: fraction 100 over 200, so half of each endorsement charge is taken back.
